result.title: From Reconstruction to Imputation: Test-Time Optimization for Missing Time-Series Channels
result.summary: Complete sensor-channel failures create a difficult form of time-series missingness: local interpolation is unavailable, and deploying a separately trained imputer for every failure pattern may be impractical. We ask whether a sequence reconstructor trained without artificial mask augmentation and then frozen can be converted into an imputer at inference time. Our method treats the missing entries of each test window as optimization variables, clamps all observations, and backpropagates through the frozen model to minimize reconstruction error only on observed coordinates. The resulting observed-self-consistency objective requires neither artificial mask augmentation nor full-channel dropout during reconstructor training. We characterize when this refinement is informative through the cross-Jacobian from missing inputs to observed residuals, and use an optional temporal-smoothness prior when that coupling is weak. Across five real-world datasets with exactly one channel synthetically masked per test window and four reconstruction architectures, no-prior test-time refinement reduces MAE relative to one-pass reconstruction in 19 of 20 dataset-backbone combinations. Compared with mask-aware imputers trained under either standard structured masks or matched full-channel dropout, the best refined reconstructor achieves the lowest MAE on two datasets and trails the strongest baseline on three. These gains require substantially more inference time and are sensitive to cross-channel coupling. Our results establish test-time self-consistency as a conditional inference-time adapter for frozen reconstruction models that complements mask-aware imputation without retraining the reconstructor.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究整条传感器通道缺失下的时间序列插补：不重训模型，而在测试时把缺失时刻的取值作为优化变量，固定观测值并在冻结的重构模型上反传，仅用观测坐标的重构误差做自洽优化，并用跨雅可比刻画该细化何时有效，必要时加时间平滑先验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「冻结 backbone + 测试时优化未观测变量 + 观测自洽目标」可能为 LVR 的推理期 latent 精化与视觉证据筛选提供线索，跨雅可比判据也可供核查「何时值得继续更新 latent」的启发性信号；但该文属时间序列领域，与多模态推理无直接关联。
